name: ob1-extensions-tests

scripts.sync-auth: for d in _shared ../recipes/_shared ../recipes/editorial-policy/_shared ../integrations/_shared ../integrations/consolidation-workers/_shared; do cp ../server-portable/auth.ts "$d/auth.ts"; done

comment: Test-only (SMD-1252, FORK.md change 64): test-auth.ts imports the seven extension servers, and since change 67 (SMD-1455) the vendored recipes' and integrations' servers, as deployed; test-writes.ts (change 69, SMD-1228; change 71, SMD-1524) drives the vendored writers of a thought's content or vector against a real Postgres; test-tools.ts (change 77, SMD-1588; SMD-1798) drives every tool of the eight MCP servers with a schema of their own — seven extensions and the ob-graph recipe — against those schemas. Versions are pinned EXACTLY to server-portable/package.json and integrations/kubernetes-deployment/package.json — one MCP stack across the tree's three installs (SMD-1800 removed the deno.json import maps that used to mirror them) — so the test exercises the libraries the servers run on; test-auth.ts fails if either drifts. Bump all three in the same commit. No types package: bun runs the test untyped, and nothing type-checks this directory. `bun run sync-auth` rewrites every _shared/auth.ts from server-portable/auth.ts; the test names the five and fails if one differs.
